academic.passage: Photosynthesis is a vital process for life on Earth, where green plants convert sunlight into chemical energy. This occurs primarily in chloroplasts within the leaves. In this process, carbon dioxide and water are transformed into glucose and oxygen. The significance of photosynthesis extends beyond energy production; it is crucial for the oxygen we breathe and forms the basis of the food chain. Understanding photosynthesis helps in addressing environmental issues and enhancing agricultural productivity.
